chapters.reason: The paper's core contribution is the System-1.x Planner, which dynamically switches between fast (System-1) and slow (System-2) reasoning modes based on problem difficulty, directly aligning with the dual-process theory and complexity-based toggling described in System Switch.

The framework balances computational cost by controlling the mixture (hybridization factor) between fast and slow planning, effectively scaling search depth and width at test time, which relates to efficient test-time scaling and balancing search strategies.

The System-1.x Planner is applied to practical planning tasks like Maze Navigation and Blocksworld, demonstrating its use in autonomous agent-like scenarios, which falls under the application of efficient reasoning techniques to real-world systems.
